entries.text: MCP server (preview) is now available. See https://www.red-gate.com/monitor14/mcp-server for details.
Redgate Assistant (RGA) (preview) is now available. See https://www.red-gate.com/monitor14/redgate-assistant for details.
A new Reports experience is now available, providing a more modern interface and improved layout. Click on the Try it out link on the Reports tab.

Added a new "Power BI Report Server status" alert, so Power BI Report Server (the successor to SQL Server Reporting Services from SQL Server 2025) can be alerted on independently from SQL Server Reporting Service.

New alert type for IO stalls is now available for SQL Server and MySQL. This alert is raised when the average time an IO operation spends stalled waiting on storage exceeds a threshold for a sustained duration.

Individual query execution monitoring is now available for Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Google Cloud SQL for SQL Server. See https://www.red-gate.com/monitor14/individual-query-executions for details.
Enterprise edition - SQL Audit is now out of preview.
The Virtual Machines page is now out of preview.

Enterprise edition - New alert type for database permission changes is now available for SQL Server instances with SQL Audit enabled. This alert is raised when a permission is granted, revoked, denied, or ownership is transferred on a database or database securables.
Google Cloud SQL monitoring is now available for PostgreSQL instances.
Google Cloud SQL monitoring is now available for SQL Server instances.

SQL Agent job monitoring is now available for Contained Availability Groups — job definitions, history, activity, and schedules are collected and surfaced in the Estate Jobs view and alert configuration.
Individual query execution monitoring is now available for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance.
Native ServiceNow and Microsoft Teams notifications are now out of preview.
Added a Spills column to the Query Executions tab showing tempdb spill counts per query.
Added effective costs (alongside billed costs) to the Estate > Virtual Machines page.
New alert type for server role membership changes — raised when a principal is added to or removed from a server role.
Added a daily costs graph to the VM details sidebar with comparison period overlay.
Added ability to see cost details of AWS EC2 instances on the Estate > Virtual Machines page.
Monitoring of PostgreSQL Aurora reader instances now supported, with automatic detection via the cluster.
Added ability to see cost details of Azure virtual machines on the Virtual Machines page.
Added an option to various alert types allowing databases to be excluded by name.
AI Alert analysis now available for Long-running query, Deadlock, and Blocking process alerts.
SQL Audit now supports SCHEMA_OBJECT_PERMISSION_CHANGE_GROUP and related permission change groups.
Custom metric alert detail text (secondary query result) now included in script and webhook notification payloads.
Custom metrics can now be configured on Oracle instances.
New alert type for SQL Audit file rollovers — raised when all audit files roll over in a single sampling interval.
Query compare is now available for PostgreSQL Top queries.
SQL Audit now supports SERVER_ROLE_MEMBER_CHANGE_GROUP and DATABASE_ROLE_MEMBER_CHANGE_GROUP action types.
Subscription details for Azure virtual machines now visible on the Virtual Machines page.
Disk read and write latency metrics added to the Analysis page for Amazon RDS hosts.
Query Executions tab now shown alongside the History tab on SQL Server instance overviews.
SQL Audit events can now be filtered by a custom date and time range.
Modernised current activity tabs for SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including CPU/memory stats per session.
New Analysis graph is now the default, with improved performance and modern design.
Added Machine: processor time (excluding hypervisor steal) metric for Linux hosts.
AI analysis of Top queries now supported for MongoDB instances.
AWS EC2 cloud details and credential management added to Estate > Virtual Machines for Monitor SaaS.
Index sampling now enabled by default for all PostgreSQL instances.
SQL Audit now supports DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_CHANGE_GROUP action types.
Custom metrics can now run an optional secondary SQL query to add context when an alert is raised.
PostgreSQL tracked queries now accessible from the database overview page.
Subscription details for AWS virtual machines now visible on the Virtual Machines page.
Top waits data now available for PostgreSQL on server overview and database details pages.
Added backup priority column for each replica on the SQL Server Availability Group page.
Current Activity pages with AI capability added for Oracle and MySQL instances.
SQL Audit now supports SERVER_PRINCIPAL_CHANGE_GROUP action types.
Added 'All databases are encrypted with TDE' rule to CIS Benchmark in Configuration Compliance.
All notification types can now be rate-limited (default 30 per alert type per server) to prevent notification overload.
Estate > Virtual Machines sidebar now displays Azure VM cloud resource details when cloud credentials are provided.
Added 'Ensure Windows BUILTIN groups are not SQL Logins' rule to CIS Compliance Template.
Added ability to search the Configuration page and add SQL Server instances on previously added Linux machines.
AI-powered query analysis (preview) now available on the Current Activity tab.
New SQL Audit tab (preview) in Security > Permissions — lists permission-affecting events. Supports self-managed and Amazon RDS SQL Server.
Virtual Machines details sidebar gains a comparison toggle to compare data across time periods.
AI-powered query analysis (preview) extended to support Oracle and MySQL instances.
Custom text can now be added to alert email notifications via the alert configuration page.
Monitoring of MySQL instances running on AWS Aurora now supported.
Permissions monitoring now available for Azure Managed Instances (Microsoft Entra ID not yet supported).
Query tracking is now available for PostgreSQL.
Support for certificate authentication when monitoring Linux PostgreSQL servers (preview).
Support for PostgreSQL 18 added.
Virtual Machines page can now compare usage with the previous time period.
AI-powered query analysis (preview) — explains why queries perform poorly and suggests improvements.
Custom metrics and alerts are now available for PostgreSQL.
Estate > SQL Server replication page showing latest replication job activity.
Added overall wait event/class graphs and tables for Oracle instances.
Estate > Virtual Machines page added to monitor VM usage across the estate.
Export all sysadmins, serveradmins, or securityadmins across all servers from the Permissions page.
Extended Oracle support with Oracle Data Guard monitoring.
Monitoring of MySQL instances on Azure Flexible Server now supported.
Native Microsoft Teams integration — sends alert notifications to Teams channels.
Native ServiceNow integration — creates incidents when alerts fire.
New Replication job failure and Replication maintenance job failure alert types for SQL Server.
Enterprise: Configuration Compliance templates can now be selectively applied to servers by tags.
Enterprise: Permissions monitoring now available for Amazon RDS SQL Server instances and databases.
Added top procedure history graph showing historical trends for most-executed procedures.
Capacity and free space of mapped network drives now shown in disk usage on server overview, with low disk space alerting.
Enhanced SQL Server waits graph with category-level grouping (lock, network I/O, latch, parallelism, etc.).
General availability of dynamic (ML-powered) alerts for CPU, Waits, Query Throughput, and DTU.
Linux machines can now be monitored on any SSH port, not just the default port 22.
Added Oracle multi-tenant container view.
Added support for sending email notifications using OAuth for Exchange Online servers.
Access tokens can now be scoped to specific groups and monitored servers with configurable roles.
Added Temp IO Waits metric to the Performance section on Oracle Server Overview.
New Performance section on Oracle Server Overview with Redo Log Switches metric.
PostgreSQL Index Monitoring now available in preview — index details and unused indexes accessible from Databases page.
Individual query execution monitoring is now out of preview.
New table overview page for PostgreSQL — covering performance, activity, vacuum, and query execution data.
Added Containers table on Oracle Server Overview when monitoring a Multi-Tenant instance.
Added Multi-Tenant information for Oracle Server Properties.
Added support for connecting to Oracle instances using a TNS Names file.
New databases tab for PostgreSQL with a database overview page summarising size, performance, and query metrics.
Top procedures can now be searched by name.
Enterprise: Sensitive action logging introduced to record user activity within the Redgate Monitor application.
Dynamic alerting for DTUs now available for Azure SQL Elastic Pools.
Dynamic alerting for DTUs now available on Azure SQL Databases.
MongoDB Server Overview now displays Top Queries.
Redgate Monitor can now use PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB as its Data Repository.
Introducing MongoDB support — monitor MongoDB instances hosted on Linux.
Introducing MySQL support — monitor MySQL instances hosted on Linux or Amazon RDS.
Introducing Oracle support — monitor Oracle instances hosted on Linux or Amazon RDS.
New query throughput alert using ML to baseline queries/sec and alert on deviation.
ML-driven dynamic alerts now generally available for the Server Waits alert.
Added support for authentication via OIDC Authorization Code with PKCE flow.
Dynamic alerting for high CPU now supported on Azure SQL Databases and Elastic Pools.
Added Signal and Resource wait times/sec graphs to the Analysis page.
Dynamic alerting for high CPU now supported on Linux, Amazon RDS, Azure Managed Instance, and Azure Flex host.
New alert for replica role changes in PostgreSQL replication — can signify failovers.
New alert for PostgreSQL log entries matching regular expressions.
New alert for Virtual Log File count exceeding a configurable threshold.
PostgreSQL Azure Flexible Server now supports Microsoft Entra ID login (managed identities and service principals).
Query Plans now supported and viewable for PostgreSQL Azure Flexible Server instances.
Error logging now available for PostgreSQL Azure Flexible Server.
Preview: individual query execution monitoring — start/end times, duration, reads/writes, and query text.
Database instance error log entry alert extended to include MySQL.
Enterprise: View permission changes in Security > Permissions page.
Preview: ML-driven dynamic alert thresholds for SQL Server on Windows.
New alert for Suspended Wait Time on SQL Server.
Preview: monitoring of PostgreSQL instances on Azure Flexible Server.
Enterprise: CIS Benchmark preset template for SQL Server 2022 added to Configuration Compliance.
Support for monitoring PostgreSQL 17 added.
Low cache hit ratio alerts now available for PostgreSQL.
Redgate Monitor repository database hosted on Amazon RDS is now supported.
Server aliases can now be set from the Configuration > Monitored Servers page.
New uptime summary tile in reports showing all servers sorted by uptime in ascending order.
New Network Utilization alert for Windows and Linux machines.
Amazon RDS and Aurora PostgreSQL now support database login via IAM credentials.
AWS-based instances with enhanced monitoring can now authenticate via an IAM role.
Significant PostgreSQL query plan changes are now visible in the top queries history view.
Replica Not Healthy alerts now available for PostgreSQL.
Enterprise: Past and current user permissions for SQL Server servers and databases now visible.
Enterprise: SQL Server configuration can be checked against custom compliance templates.
SQL Monitor rebranded to Redgate Monitor. New Enterprise edition adds Security Permissions, Configuration Compliance, and REST API.
Added excessive planning time recommendation for PostgreSQL top queries.
Added support for aliasing PostgreSQL instances.
New alert for replication lag on PostgreSQL instances.
Daily custom metrics can now be scheduled for specific times of day.
Azure Managed Instances can now be monitored using Microsoft Entra Managed Identity authentication.
Azure SQL Databases can now be monitored using Microsoft Entra Managed Identity authentication.
New 'Long-running transaction' and 'Long-running idle transaction' alerts for PostgreSQL.
Configuration change alerts now available for PostgreSQL.
Added option to send webhook notifications for 'All Levels', 'High and Medium', or 'High Only' alerts.
Recommendations can now be viewed in the query plan viewer for PostgreSQL.
Added spill-to-disk query recommendation for PostgreSQL Top Queries.
Added CSV export to the main indexes table.
Added Top Query Search functionality for PostgreSQL.
Server overview for PostgreSQL now displays configuration options.
SQL Server index information now available as a new tab in the server overview.
Backups Estate page now includes SQL Server on Linux, Azure Managed Instances, and Amazon RDS SQL Servers.
Disk Usage Estate page now includes SQL Server on Linux and Amazon RDS SQL Servers.
SQL Server Configuration Estate page now includes Azure SQL Databases.
Support for monitoring PostgreSQL v16 added.
SQL Server Licensing Estate page now includes SQL Server on Linux.
Storage alerts now configurable on Elastic Pools.
A PowerShell script can now be run as an alert response action.
Beta support for monitoring Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL instances.
SQL Server Versions Estate page now supports SQL Server on Linux, Azure Managed Instances, and Amazon RDS.
SQL Agent Jobs Estate page now supports SQL Server on Linux, Azure Managed Instances, and Amazon RDS.
SQL Server Configuration page now supports SQL Server on Linux.
Recommendations based on actual query plan warnings (e.g. spill to tempdb) now available where actual plan collection is enabled.
You can now select which Azure SQL Databases to monitor.
Added incoming replication charts for PostgreSQL monitoring.
Connect to Azure Managed Instances and Azure SQL Databases using Azure Active Directory – Integrated authentication.
PostgreSQL physical streaming replication data now monitored and visible in the server overview.
Deadlock rate alerts now available for PostgreSQL.
Connect to Azure Managed Instances and Azure SQL Databases using Azure Active Directory – Password authentication.
Linux hosts can now be connected securely using SSH public key authentication.
High Transaction ID consumption alerts now available for PostgreSQL.
Transaction ID consumption now available in the PostgreSQL metric section of the Analysis page.
New 'Percentage of connections used' alert for PostgreSQL instances.
SQL Server error log entry alert extended to PostgreSQL and renamed to 'Database instance error log entry'.
PowerShell API now supports SQL Server on Linux.
Introducing PostgreSQL support — monitor PostgreSQL instances hosted on Linux or Amazon RDS.
Monitoring SQL Server on Linux is now out of preview.
Actual query plans can now be viewed in addition to estimated plans for SQL Server 2019 and later.
SQL Server on Linux information now available in reports.
Added expand functionality on top procedures to display the constituent queries.
Alert suppression now available for SQL Server on Linux.
Metrics for SQL Server on Linux now viewable on the Analysis page.
New Page Life Expectancy alert.
Added Top Procedures to the performance diagnostics section of the server overview.
Preview release of monitoring SQL Servers on Linux machines.
Windows account impersonation now supported when connecting to Amazon RDS SQL Servers for monitoring.
Added support for connecting to Amazon RDS SQL Server as the Base Monitor's service account.
SQL Deadlock Extended Event alerts now supported on Amazon RDS SQL Server.
Query tracking in top queries section now available — tracked queries appear in a new dedicated tab.
Memory metrics now shown in the server overview activity graph and Analysis page for Azure SQL Managed Instances.
New Impact view for top queries, ordering queries by their impact.
Query recommendations now available in the top queries expanded view.
Tags can now be used to specify which servers are included in an alert suppression window.
Added 'Memory grant (kB)' column to the top queries table.
AD (LDAP) authentication can now be configured using the Base Monitor service account, including gMSA accounts.
PowerShell API now supports adding and removing tags on SQL Server, Amazon RDS, and Azure SQL Managed Instances.
Current Activity now supports filtering.
SQL Monitor now detects if an Azure SQL Managed Instance is part of a failover group and shows its replication state.
Current Activity is now out of preview, with full support for Azure MI, Azure SQL, Amazon RDS, and on-prem SQL Server.
Tagging and filtering by tags is now out of preview.
Current Activity page now supports Azure Managed Instances, Amazon RDS SQL Servers, and Azure SQL Databases.
Redesigned alert inbox with fresh look and support for tags.
New version store usage alert added.
Current Activity now available from the Server Overview page for on-prem SQL Server instances.
Tagging of SQL Server, Azure SQL Databases, Azure Managed Instances, and Amazon RDS instances now available.
New permit-based licensing system fully supporting the SQL Monitor subscription offering.
SQL Server Configuration Options Estate page is now out of preview.
Top Queries search bar is now out of preview.
